prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same pieces, their order, names and sizes. Crag biome nature kit, 19 pieces, labels exactly as written in quotes, sizes as width x height. Row 1, TREES: "Wind-bent pine A" 8 x 6.5 m (thick twisted brown-grey trunk leaning hard over, broad flat-topped crown of three or four layered needle pads swept to one side, roots gripping small stones); "Wind-bent pine B" 7 x 6 m (taller S-curved bonsai trunk, a high main pad plus two or three smaller pads stepping down the same downwind side, roots over a low rock); "Juniper A, sprawling" 4 x 2 m (low twisted pale silver-grey limbs crawling along the ground, dense green clumps on top, bare dead tips); "Juniper B, on rock" 3.5 x 3 m (grows sideways out of a blocky lichen-spotted cragslate chunk, one small green clump, the rest bleached silver deadwood). Row 2, PLANTS AND GROUND: "Cushion plant" 1 x 0.4 m (tight moss-green dome dotted with tiny white and pink flowers); "Alpine flowers" 0.7 x 0.45 m (blue gentian bells, white stars and pink sprays on a leaf rosette); "Wind-flattened grass clump" 1.4 x 0.6 m (long gold-green blades combed flat downwind); "Turf patch" 1.8 x 0.2 m (thin alpine turf mat with ragged torn edge); "Scree pile" 1.6 x 0.8 m (conical heap of sharp grey-blue shards); "Lichen rock" 1.4 x 0.9 m (rounded grey-blue boulder crusted with pale green and orange lichen). Row 3, ROCK: "Cragslate boulder" 2.4 x 1.6 m (tilted layered slab block, sharp diagonal strata); "Split boulder" 1.8 x 1.9 m (two tall leaning slab halves with a clean cleft); "Ledge outcrop" 3 x 1.5 m (stacked slabs stepping out into a flat turf-topped shelf); "Natural stair" 3 x 1.8 m (five or six slab steps rising between two low rock cheeks); "Spire rock" 2 x 4 m (cluster of tall sharp vertical blades to one point); "Cinder rock" 2.2 x 1.6 m (cinder-black pitted porous block with rust-red scorch patches); "Ore-seam rock" 2.2 x 1.7 m (dark cinder-grey layered block cut by bright copper-gold ore seams). Row 4, ISLE EDGE: "Lip segment, cragslate" 8 x 5 m (thin turf with pink and white flowers over layered grey-blue slab ledges breaking into hanging points, flat cut ends so segments tile side by side, no tree on it); "Underside taper, cragslate" 8 x 10 m (downward-tapering stack of stepped grey-blue strata ending in several hanging points, no gold seams and no waterfall). Grey-blue cragslate and gold-green turf as in the attached sheet. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Crag nature kit".
